items.name: Tirol Open 2019
items.information: 2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol! Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte. Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab! ______ 2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol! Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well. The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2019 will crown the National Champions in all 18 official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Nuevamente el Palacio de la Juventud y la Municipalidad de Los Olivos nos brindarán su apoyo para llevar a cabo este torneo de speedsolving. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la [pestaña “Horario" (Schedule)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la [pestaña “Categorías” (Events)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. **ENGLISH** Once again Palacio de la Juventud and Municipalidad de Los Olivos are supporting another speedsolving competition. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information: Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve. Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition. **Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.** **REPAS** : Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition. Samedi soir, pour 10€ : * Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser) * Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau Dimanche soir pour 15€ : * Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J) * Un dessert, comme le samedi **LASER GAME** : Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€. Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! --- You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event. We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition. **Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.** **DINNERS**: On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue. Saturday evening for 10€: * "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us) * A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake Sunday evening for 15€: * A big pizza (to be chosen on the day) * A dessert, like on Saturday **LASER GAME**: On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€. Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

items.name: UK Championship 2019
items.information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **Qualification Requirements**: If you do not meet the qualification requirements in competition *before* 11 October 2019, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the [Qualification tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKChampionship2019#9139-qualification) to see all times required. **Final Round Advancements**: For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors. **Please Note**: As this is the UK Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

items.information: This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons. We are excited to be bringing all 18 official WCA events to the area, which doesn't get many competitions. The first CCC competition had only 8 events and 23 competitors, so this time we're making it bigger and better! Friday is reserved for big BLD and feet, so you can arrive just for Saturday and Sunday if you aren't interested in that subset of events.

items.information: **Português** O KubeKids é o 10º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - No momento da premiação, no final do domingo, vamos sortear alguns cubos para os competidores. Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** KubeKids is the 10th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: Chignahuapan, *pueblo mágico*, es el principal productor de esferas en todo el país, bello por folklor y sus paisajes naturales como la laguna de Chignahuapan, las cascadas de Quetzalapan, las aguas termales y sus bosques. Han pasado casi 8 años desde el primer Reto Chignahuapan, es hora de traer uno nuevo y no hay otra mejor manera que con un gran torneo. Este torneo es posible gracias al staff del ***Puebla Rubik’s Team*** y al ***Gobierno municipal de Chignahuapan.*** ![](https://i.imgur.com/17KskVW.jpg) Chignahuapan, *pueblo magico*, is the main manufacturer of Christmas spheres in Mexico. Chignahuapan is beautiful because its folklore and its natural landscapes are amazing. 8 years have passed since the first *Reto Chignahuapan*, it's time to bring a new one but in shape of 2019 This tournament is supported to ***Puebla Rubik's Team*** staff and ***Chignahuapan municipal government***

items.information: Otago October 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the Rubik's Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Navojoa, Sonora mejor conocida como La Perla del Mayo, es una bonita ciudad ubicada en el Sur de Sonora, rodeada de Sierra, Mar y Desierto. La tribu Mayo habita el sur de Sonora desde hace cientos de años, entre sus tradiciones mas destacadas podemos mencionar la danza del venado que es conocida a nivel internacional. La competencia del **Open del Mayo 2019** se desarrollara en el **CAS del Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora** principal universidad de la region, que cuenta con comodas instalaciones que permitiran a los participantes dar sus mejores tiempos. The Mayo tribe inhabits southern Sonora for hundreds of years, among its most outstanding traditions we can mention the deer dance that is known internationally. The competition del **Open del Mayo 2019** will be held at the **CAS of the Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora**, the main university in the region, which has comfortable facilities that will allow participants to give their best times. items.information: Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

venue.name: [Wellington College](https://www.wellington-college.school.nz/facility-hire)
venue.address: 15 Dufferin St, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6021, New Zealand

items.information: Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then. Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con el organizador El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el viernes 31 de mayo o hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. **ENGLISH** This is the first competition sponsored by Black Horse Toys store. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. REGISTRATION: A register is considered complete when electronic registration has been completed and payment has been made (registration fees and payment methods are detailed at Registration requirements section). Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the Schedule tab. Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the Events tab. It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID. *Competitors who come from outside Lima will have to contact the organizer in order to coordinate the payment method. Registration will stay opened till May 31 or till competitor limit is reached.

items.information: **UPDATE** (March 9): The competition has reached the 60-competitor limit, and a number of people now have registrations on the waiting list. Registration has now been closed. In the event of any cancellation, we will accept people from the waiting list in the order in which they have paid the registration fee. STMHS is holding its first WCA competition in May! This competition is planned to help lower the costs of graduation caps and gowns for seniors in STMHS and bring some love to Connecticut cubing. (And then some!) The events consist of some NxNxN puzzles (2x2 up to 5x5, including 3x3 Blindfolded) as well as more unorthodox puzzles (Skewb, Square-1, Pyraminx). 2x2 and 3x3 will have two rounds while the rest of the events will only have one round. Guests are welcome, though it will be appreciated to inform us on how many each competitor will plan on having with them on their registration forms. To the right of the venue is New London High School which has a free parking lot, though its capacity becoming full throughout the day is unknown.

items.information: Welcome to this blind events only competition in Tullinge, just outside Stockholm! We will only have blindsolving events at this competition. However, registration is free and the time-limits are lenient, so we would like to see many of you gathered for this competition in April! Please read through all the tabs on this page to get all the information you need for this competition. The main event of this competition is **3x3x3 Blindfolded**. If you have any further questions, feel free to contact the organizers using the contact information on this page. We are not allowed to wear outside shoes inside the venue, and the floor tend to get a bit cold as it is in a basement. Therefore, a good tip is to bring some slippers or inside shoes to keep your feet warm during the day. ----- Varmt välkomna till denna tävling med bara blindgrenar i Tullinge, strax utanför Stockholm! Vi kommer bara ha blindgrenar på denna tävling. Det är dock gratis att delta och alla time-limits är generöst satta, så vi hoppas se många av er på denna tävling i april! Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att få all information om denna tävling. Tävlingens huvudgren är **3x3x3 med Ögonbindel** Om du har ytterligare frågor så går det bra att kontakta arrangörerna genom kontaktinformationen på denna sida. Det är inte tillåtet att ha på sig utomhusskor inne i tävlingslokalen och golvet tenderar och bli ganska kallt då lokalen ligger i en källare. items.information: Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con la tienda Speedcuber Perú al 991817714 o al 7505980. El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el jueves 18 de abril o y hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, **solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 06 de abril.**

Регистрация с неправильно введенным именем и фамилией не будут приняты, пожалуйста внимательно проверьте внесенные данные. Подача заявки и оплата взноса за участие или входного билета гостя/зрителя означает, что Вы ознакомлены и согласны с правилами проведения чемпионата Если вы ознакомились с условиями регистрации и условиями оплаты взноса на вкладке "Как оплатить участие (Payment information)", то вы можете перейти к регистрации. ВНИМАНИЕ!!! 1. Если участник приходит без совершеннолетнего сопровождающего, то он обязан при себе иметь письменное заявление-согласие от родителей либо опекунов, о том, что они самостоятельно несут ответственность за несовершеннолетнего ребенка. 2. Головоломки используемые в соревнованиях должны иметь отличительные отметки, по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец (например: нацарапанные инициалы или имя с внутренней стороны съемной крышки) ====================================================== После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). В день соревнований участнику и гостю при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. For more info please visit our [VK Group](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019). Before submitting the application, read the registration information. Registration with incorrect first and last name will not be accepted, please carefully check the entered data. Submitting an application and paying a participation fee or a guest / viewer entrance ticket means that you acquainted and agree with the rules of the championship If you have read the terms of registration and the terms of payment of the fee in the tab "How to pay / How to pay for participation", then you can proceed to registration. **ATTENTION!!! 1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child. 2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover) ** After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation. Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend). On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.

items.name: Austrian Open 2019
items.information: Autrian Open 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other related puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. This competition is NOT a national championship for Austria.
